research_question: Effect of protected complete-case feedback budget on fixed-case algorithm development
provider_usage: record actual reported usage; missing or zero-filled fields are unknown
repetitions_semantics: independent development processes; provider sampling seed is unavailable and is not claimed controlled
case_policy: one identical complete case for development feedback and final evaluation per task; no calendar generalization claim

feedback_policy.n_is: maximum accepted complete-case process evaluations; final replay is separate
feedback_policy.infrastructure_failure: record separately; retry only the same evaluation identity
feedback_policy.unused_budget: allowed; report accepted and collected counts
feedback_policy.public_checks: interface and synthetic toy checks only; no real target trajectory or free target score
feedback_policy.feedback_precision: aggregate metrics and reward as emitted by the frozen scorer; no trajectories

final_policy: one controller.py at the wall-clock deadline, artifact hash verified in independent terminal replay; never select best feedback history

mapdn.information: one current regional observation per PV per interval; private actor history; no shared state or extra simulator calls
mapdn.quality: if all bus-time voltage points comply: 0.5+0.5/(1+actual_active_loss_MWh); otherwise 0.5*bus_time_compliance

reference_roles.full_information_ac_opf: privileged network-information reference; no global optimality claim

powergym.information: causal device states, previous completed-hour bus-phase voltages and battery actual power; initial observation uses hour0 initial state; no load trajectory or simulator query
powergym.voltage_feasibility: soft cost, separately report compliance; not a hard candidate-validity gate
powergym.numerics: OpenDSS tolerance1e-10, BuildYMatrix(2,True), SolutionInitialized=False for every query; original Generator Q=P/pf; Python round integer-kWh ledger

reference_roles.coordinated_voltage: same-information executable reference and common starter
reference_roles.strong_current_idle: privileged current load and circuit optimization reference
reference_roles.oracle_day_storage: privileged full-day storage reference, fixed device plan; no joint global optimality claim

release_gate: exact new package real-backend reference alignment, target-cluster sandbox/runtime acceptance, native lifecycle and source/image/config freeze before submission
historical_results: preserved; this 30-run extension is separate from the original 75-run cohort and 600-second canaries
